questions.question: Short polling, long polling, SSE va WebSocket — farqi?
options: Short polling — client doim qayta so'raydi (oddiy, isrofgarchilik). Long polling — server ma'lumot paydo bo'lguncha javobni ushlab turadi. SSE — serverdan clientga bir tomonlama uzluksiz oqim (HTTP ustida, avtomatik qayta connection). WebSocket — ikki tomonlama doimiy connection
WebSocket HTTP emas va proxy'lardan o'tmaydi
questions.explanation: Tanlov qoidasi: faqat serverdan yangilik kerakmi (narx, bildirishnoma, progress) — SSE yetarli va soddaroq; chat, o'yin, hamkorlikdagi tahrir kabi ikki tomonlama aloqa kerakmi — WebSocket. Long polling — eski client/proxy'lar uchun zaxira variant.

questions.question: SSE ning WebSocket'ga nisbatan amaliy afzalligi?
options: Oddiy HTTP: mavjud autentifikatsiya, proxy va load balancer bilan muammosiz ishlaydi, avtomatik qayta connection va Last-Event-ID bilan uzilgan joydan davom etish qo'llab-quvvatlanadi
questions.explanation: Cheklovlari: faqat matn (UTF-8), HTTP/1.1 da domenga connection'lar soni cheklangan (HTTP/2 da bu muammo yo'q), ba'zi proxy'lar javobni buferlashi mumkin (nginx'da proxy_buffering off). Serverda har connection resurs — goroutine/thread modeli va connection'lar soni rejalashtirilishi kerak.

questions.question: WebSocket'li servisni masshtablashda qanday muammolar chiqadi?
modelAnswer: Connection stateful: LB sticky bo'lishi yoki connection qayerdaligini bilish kerak (presence/registry)
Bir foydalanuvchiga xabar yuborish uchun uning qaysi instance'ga ulanganini topish — odatda Redis Pub/Sub yoki mesh orqali fan-out
Deploy: har deployda hamma connection uziladi — client tomonda backoff bilan qayta connection va holatni tiklash shart
Resurs: har connection memory va fayl deskriptori; connection'lar soniga limit va gorizontal masshtab
Sog'liq: heartbeat/ping-pong bilan o'lik connection'larni tozalash; idle timeout'lar LB bilan muvofiq
Backpressure: sekin client uchun bufer cheklovi va uzish siyosati
questions.explanation: Senior signal: 'stateful connection stateless servis modelini buzadi' va deploy/qayta connection strategiyasini aytish. Ko'pincha soddaroq yechim — SSE yoki push notification.

questions.question: WebSocket, SSE va long polling — Go'da qaysi biri qachon?
options: SSE — faqat serverdan clientga oqim (oddiy, HTTP ustida, avtomatik qayta ulanish); WebSocket — ikki tomonlama (chat, o'yin); long polling — eski clientlar uchun zaxira; tanlov yo'nalish va infratuzilmaga (proxy, LB timeout) bog'liq
questions.explanation: Go'da: SSE — oddiy handler + http.Flusher (yoki ResponseController), hech qanday kutubxona kerak emas; WebSocket — nhooyr/coder websocket yoki gorilla. Masshtablashda asosiy muammo — holat: ulanish bitta podda, shuning uchun Redis pub/sub yoki Centrifugo kabi broker orqali fan-out kerak. LB/proxy idle timeout'idan qisqa heartbeat (ping) yuborilishi shart.

questions.question: WebSocket bilan 200k ulanishni bir necha podda ushlab turasiz. Foydalanuvchiga xabar yuborish kerak, lekin u qaysi podda ekani noma'lum. Eng to'g'ri arxitektura?
options: Pub/Sub (Redis/NATS/Kafka) fan-out: har pod o'zining ulanishlariga tegishli kanalga subscribe bo'ladi
Har pod barcha foydalanuvchilar ulanishini saqlaydi
questions.explanation: Standart pattern: ulanish holati podda (local), yo'naltirish pub/sub orqali. Redis pub/sub oddiy lekin at-most-once — pod ulanmagan payt xabar yo'qoladi; kafolat kerak bo'lsa Kafka/NATS JetStream + per-user offset. Presence uchun TTL'li Redis kalit (`presence:user:42 -> podID`, heartbeat bilan yangilanadi).

questions.question: WebSocket ulanish 60 sekunddan keyin jim uziladi, xato log yo'q. Eng ehtimolli sabab?
options: Oradagi L7 proxy/LB yoki NAT idle timeout — ping/pong keepalive yo'q
questions.explanation: nginx `proxy_read_timeout` default 60s, ALB idle timeout 60s, NAT/conntrack jadvali ham idle flow'ni tashlaydi. Yechim: server tomondan davriy `ping` (20-30s) va `pong` deadline; proxy timeout'ni ping intervalidan katta qilish. Bundan tashqari client'da exponential backoff + resume token bilan reconnect kerak.

questions.question: Realtime kanalda at-least-once yetkazib berish kerak. Client reconnect qilganda xabarlar yo'qolmasligi uchun?
options: Har xabarga monoton `seq`/offset berish; client oxirgi ko'rgan seq'ni reconnect'da yuborib, serverdan qolganini so'raydi
questions.explanation: TCP faqat ulanish ichida tartib beradi — uzilish oralig'idagi xabarlar yo'q. Shuning uchun per-kanal cursor: server oxirgi N xabarni (yoki stream'ni) saqlaydi, client `Last-Event-ID`/seq bilan resume qiladi (SSE'da bu standart). Dublikat bo'lishi mumkin — client dedupe qiladi, ya'ni idempotent qo'llash.

questions.question: Bir yo'nalishli server→client oqim uchun SSE va WebSocket qaysi holatda afzal?
options: SSE: faqat server→client, HTTP/1.1+ oddiy, avtomatik reconnect va Last-Event-ID bor, proxy'lar bilan do'st; WebSocket: ikki yo'nalishli, binary, past latency
questions.explanation: Notification/progress/feed uchun SSE arzon va operatsion jihatdan sodda (oddiy HTTP, LB muammosi kam, auth cookie/header ishlaydi). Cheklov: HTTP/1.1'da brauzer per-domen ulanish limiti (~6) va faqat text; HTTP/2 multiplexing bilan bu yengillashadi. Ikki yo'nalish yoki juda tez almashinuv kerak bo'lsa — WebSocket.

questions.question: WebSocket gateway'ni deploy qilayotganda 200k ulanish bir zumda uzilib, hammasi qayta ulanadi (thundering herd). Qanday oldini olasiz?
modelAnswer: Graceful drain: pod `SIGTERM` olgach yangi ulanish qabul qilmaydi, mavjudlarini bosqichma-bosqich (masalan 1-2% / sekund) yopadi va client'ga 'reconnect after N' hint yuboradi
Client'da jitterli exponential backoff — barchasi bir vaqtda qaytmasin
Rolling deploy: maxUnavailable kichik, surge cheklangan; kanareyka bilan avval 5% pod
Auth/handshake narxi katta bo'lsa — resume token bilan arzon reconnect yo'li
Reconnect paytdagi 'catch-up' o'qishni rate-limit va cache orqali berish, DB'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri urmaslik
questions.explanation: Reconnect bo'roni ko'pincha o'zi incident'ni keltiradi: handshake + auth + state yuklash bir vaqtda kelib DB va identity servisini o'ldiradi. Shuning uchun uzish ham, qaytish ham asta bo'lishi kerak.

questions.question: WebSocket'da autentifikatsiya: qaysi yondashuv to'g'ri?
options: Token'ni query string'da yuborish eng yaxshi
Handshake'da (header yoki qisqa muddatli ticket) tekshirish, ulanish davomida token muddati tugashini alohida kuzatib davriy re-auth qilish
Bir marta auth qilib umrbod ishonish
questions.explanation: Brauzer WebSocket API custom header bermaydi, shuning uchun qisqa TTL'li (10-60s) bir martalik ticket olinadi va `?ticket=` bilan ulanadi (query'dagi uzoq muddatli JWT log'larga tushadi — leak). Ulanish uzoq yashaydi: token/scope o'zgarsa yoki muddati tugasa — server ulanishni yopadi yoki re-auth frame talab qiladi, aks holda revoke ishlamaydi.

questions.question: WebSocket gateway'da per-client backpressure qanday qilinadi?
options: Har client uchun chegaralangan yozuv navbati: to'lsa — eski xabarlarni tashlash (fan-out telemetriya uchun), yoki snapshot bilan almashtirish (holat oqimida), yoki ulanishni uzish (slow consumer); yozuvda deadline (`SetWriteDeadline`) majburiy
questions.explanation: Cheksiz bufer — OOM va butun gateway yiqilishi. Siyosat ma'lumot turiga bog'liq: narx oqimida oxirgi qiymat muhim (conflate — eskisini yangisi bilan almashtirish), chatda esa yo'qotish mumkin emas (shuning uchun clientni uzib, u qayta ulanib kursordan davom etadi). Metrikalar: tashlangan xabarlar, navbat uzunligi taqsimoti, uzilgan sekin clientlar.

questions.question: Real-time tizimda 'presence' (kim onlayn) nega qiyin?
options: Ulanish uzilishini darhol bilib bo'lmaydi (TCP jim o'ladi) — heartbeat + TTL kerak; N foydalanuvchi × M kuzatuvchi fan-out portlashi; va tez-tez o'zgaruvchi holat (flapping) — shuning uchun debounce, faqat ko'rinadigan kontaktlarga yuborish va taxminiy holat qabul qilinadi
questions.explanation: Amaliy dizayn: Redis'da `presence:<user>` kaliti TTL bilan (heartbeat har 20-30s yangilaydi), o'zgarishlar pub/sub orqali faqat kerakli kuzatuvchilarga, va 'last seen' taxminiy aniqlik bilan. Aniq real-time presence katta miqyosda juda qimmat — mahsulot talabini yumshatish (masalan '5 daqiqa ichida faol') to'g'ri muhandislik qarori.

questions.question: WebSocket o'rniga long polling qachon hali ham to'g'ri tanlov?
options: Eski/cheklangan infratuzilma (WebSocket'ni o'tkazmaydigan proksi), juda kam va noregulyar yangilanishlar, yoki mavjud HTTP autentifikatsiya/kesh qatlamidan foydalanish kerak bo'lganda; shuningdek fallback sifatida
questions.explanation: Long polling narxi: har sikl yangi so'rov (header overhead, ulanish o'rnatish), server tomonda uzoq ochiq so'rovlar (goroutine va timeout boshqaruvi). Lekin operatsion jihatdan oddiy: oddiy HTTP monitoringi, LB va auth ishlaydi. Ko'p tizim SSE'ni o'rtacha yechim sifatida tanlaydi — bir yo'nalishli oqim uchun yetarli va sodda.

questions.question: Real-time narx oqimida (masalan birja) sekin client uchun to'g'ri strategiya?
options: Conflation: oxirgi qiymat muhim — har instrument uchun navbatda faqat oxirgi yangilanish saqlanadi (eskisi almashtiriladi), va yuborish chastotasi cheklanadi (masalan 10 Hz); shunda sekin client eskirgan ma'lumot to'plamaydi
questions.explanation: Bu naqsh moliyaviy va telemetriya oqimlarida standart: navbat o'rniga `map[instrument]lastValue` + davriy flush. Chat yoki buyurtma eventlarida esa conflation mumkin emas (har xabar muhim) — u yerda backpressure boshqacha hal qilinadi (uzish + kursordan tiklanish).
